tasks.short: Develop and implement individualized tutoring interventions

steps.what: Review student evidence and agree needs and goals with relevant people
Assemble intervention plan sections with evidence links and agreed goals
Identify suitable intervention strategies and agree the final tutoring plan
Implement intervention strategies and adapt support in response to student progress

tasks.design: Use a versioned template in {DOCS} to reuse evidence links and agreed goals in the intervention plan. Strategy selection, agreement with responsible staff and implementation remain human; the template does not infer support eligibility or create an official education plan autonomously.
tasks.previous_blocker: Plans repeat evidence references and agreed goal statements across sections.
tasks.enabler_now: Native document fields and reusable sections can reduce copying while preserving provenance.
tasks.still_hard: Choosing an effective intervention and interpreting the student's response require educational judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The tutor builds trust and adjusts support to the student's actual difficulties.
tasks.altitude: Use a clearer evidence trail while retaining the same intervention responsibilities.

reach.task: Agree how tutoring interventions fit classroom support
reach.learn: Local plan authority and shared progress criteria

evidence.claim: Reusing approved fields and evidence links can reduce plan copying; the saving is an E1 scenario rather than an educational outcome finding.

assumptions: Boundary includes needs review, intervention plan documentation and implementation. Detailed lesson plans and newly authored handouts belong to separate tasks and are not saved again here.

The tutor produces student pseudonymous reference, source-work links and dates, agreed goal wording, responsible people and review criteria in s1. All capture and consultation retain 30 hours; s2 checks these fields within 12 remaining hours. Missing evidence is manually obtained, never filled by inference.
Use native document templates first. Existing template use earns no new saving.
The tutor acts within local authority. The US plan terminology does not grant authority to diagnose, determine eligibility or approve statutory plans in a European setting.
Other staff consultation and existing approval processes remain unchanged; no work is transferred to them to achieve the estimate.
unknowns: Local intervention responsibilities and plan requirements
Extent of repeated copying after existing templates
research_questions: Does a linked template reduce documentation time while keeping evidence and agreed goals accurate?

already_counted.description: Template field checking and missing data

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=30+12+20+30=92; gross 8%, less 2 upkeep gives net 6%. Low 0 when templates already exist or evidence capture expands.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Prepare and facilitate small-group tutoring sessions

steps.what: Prepare tutoring workshops by selecting existing activities and assembling session resources
Facilitate tutoring workshops, collaborative projects or academic support sessions for students

tasks.design: Use reusable resource packs in {DOCS} and existing {CALENDAR} arrangements to assemble materials already selected by the tutor. The tutor checks suitability and facilitates the group, retaining live explanation, collaboration and feedback.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated session preparation includes finding and assembling already approved resources.
tasks.enabler_now: Native folders, resource links and pack templates reduce assembly without generating teaching decisions.
tasks.still_hard: Groups need pacing, encouragement and responses to different levels of understanding.
tasks.human_edge: The tutor notices who is excluded or confused and changes the activity in real time.
tasks.altitude: Reduce resource assembly while keeping all live group support time.

reach.task: Confirm group objectives and follow-up needs
reach.learn: Align group practice with classroom learning

evidence.claim: Tutor CoPilot's trial reported improved topic mastery from tutor suggestions; it does not measure the preparation saving assumed here.
Native resource-pack reuse can reduce assembly; the proposed time estimate is model knowledge.

assumptions: Boundary is session-specific resource selection, assembly and facilitation; creation of original lessons or materials is excluded and must not be counted again from other tasks.

In s1 the tutor verifies group objective, intended activity IDs, resource versions, access needs and session details. Its 12 remaining hours cover selection, capture, checking and coordination. No structured group-needs profile is supplied for free.
The activity library contains existing approved resources; missing or unsuitable materials require normal manual preparation and reduce savings.
Try native pack templates first; no new learner profiling or automated allocation is introduced.
unknowns: Share of preparation spent on repeated resource assembly
research_questions: How much assembly time remains after tutors check a reused pack against the group?

already_counted.description: Resource selection, pack checking and arrangements

incremental.description: Maintain resource links and pack versions

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=12+80=92; gross 8%, less 2 upkeep gives net 6%. Low 0 for unique sessions or existing pack reuse. No facilitation time is removed.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Prepare lesson plans and learning modules for tutoring

steps.what: Confirm students' needs and goals and select source content for tutoring plans
Prepare lesson plans with sequenced activities, explanations and checks for understanding

loop.purpose: Draft a lesson sequence for the tutor's explicit objective
loop.input: Lesson brief and selected curriculum sources
loop.output: Draft activity sequence, explanations and learning checks with source references
loop.check: Tutor checks factual explanations, prerequisite fit, realistic pacing and whether activities actually exercise the stated goal; solves proposed checks independently
loop.stop: One draft and at most two revisions, then tutor writes unusable sections manually
loop.why_not_simpler: Use an existing suitable lesson first; adapting explanations and sequencing to a new brief requires semantic drafting beyond a fixed template

steps.what: Check lesson suitability, edit the final plan and retain the approved version

tasks.design: Try reusable lessons in {LMS} and {DOCS} first, then use a bounded drafting loop only for a genuinely new lesson brief. The tutor validates the educational content and saves the final plan; no student-facing instruction or assessment is automatically issued.
tasks.previous_blocker: Turning individual goals into a coherent sequence requires repeated drafting and adaptation.
tasks.enabler_now: A bounded model can propose a sequence from tutor-selected sources, leaving suitability and final content human.
tasks.still_hard: A plausible sequence may contain misconceptions or activities that miss the student's actual difficulty.
tasks.human_edge: The tutor judges prerequisites, motivation and the next useful learning step.
tasks.altitude: Use first drafts to spend more preparation time checking teaching choices.

reach.task: Confirm curriculum alignment of proposed tutoring lessons
reach.learn: Distinguish prerequisite practice from a new learning objective

evidence.claim: Easygenerator can turn source documents or slide decks into a first course draft.
LessonUp supports rewriting text for difficulty, summarization and translation; this supports limited content adaptation, not validated individual lesson planning.
The lesson-planning time estimate is an unmeasured E1 scenario.

assumptions: Boundary ends at a checked lesson plan; delivery, official intervention decisions and creation of standalone handouts are separate tasks. Shared preparation must be assigned once in any roll-up.

The tutor produces objective, prerequisite evidence, intended duration, learner level, access constraints and source references in s1 with all 30 hours retained. No automatic diagnosis, inferred ability score or ready learner profile is assumed.
s2's remaining 20.25 hours include prompting, source selection refinements, draft inspection, revisions and manual fallback; s3's 25 hours retain the final educational check.
Use an existing native lesson or template where suitable before any loop. Use minimized or pseudonymous information in an approved environment; unsuitable access means manual drafting.
research_questions: Do independent tutors find the draft explanations and checks appropriate for the brief?
Does preparation time fall after including failed drafts and checking?

already_counted.description: Loop operation, review and manual fallback

incremental.description: Maintain approved sources, prompts and quality examples

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=30+20.25+25=75.25; gross 24.75%, less 4 upkeep gives net 20.75%. Low 0 when an existing lesson suffices or rejected drafts consume the saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Develop tutoring handouts, study materials and quizzes

steps.what: Select teaching objectives, trusted sources and material format
Develop handouts, study materials or quizzes from the selected sources

loop.purpose: Draft or adapt a teaching resource from selected content
loop.input: Material format, objective, level and selected sources
loop.output: Draft resource with source mapping and quiz explanations where applicable
loop.check: Tutor verifies each claim against sources, independently solves every question, checks ambiguity and ensures examples exercise the objective at the intended level
loop.stop: One draft and at most two revisions; unsuitable items are manually rewritten or removed
loop.why_not_simpler: Reuse existing resources first; producing new explanations and questions needs semantic drafting rather than deterministic layout alone

steps.what: Validate teaching materials and answer keys, edit and save the final resource

tasks.design: Reuse suitable resources from {DOCS} or {LMS} before requesting new content. A bounded loop drafts from tutor-selected sources; the tutor validates every question and explanation and saves the final resource without automatic release to students.
tasks.previous_blocker: Creating explanations, examples and question variants repeatedly takes drafting time.
tasks.enabler_now: A source-constrained draft can accelerate content production while a tutor retains the answer and suitability checks.
tasks.still_hard: Questions can have ambiguous wording, incorrect answers or a difficulty mismatch.
tasks.human_edge: The tutor understands likely misconceptions and whether the material helps the intended learner.
tasks.altitude: Shift resource-authoring effort toward checking accuracy and learning value.

reach.task: Check compatibility of tutoring resources with taught methods
reach.learn: Accepted notation, solution methods and common misconceptions

evidence.claim: LessonUp offers text difficulty changes, summaries, translation and word-list definitions.
Easygenerator creates a first course draft from source documents or slides.
New quiz drafting and the time saving require local validation and are E1 design assumptions.

assumptions: Boundary is original resource authoring through internal validation; selecting an existing resource for a workshop and sequencing a lesson are excluded. Count shared source review only once in a team roll-up.

The tutor produces objective, format, level, permitted source passages, access needs and any supplied reference solution in s1, retaining all 20 hours. The model's answer explanation is not treated as a verified key.
s2 retains 24 hours for briefing, review, revisions and manual fallback; s3 retains 20 for independent answer checks and final editing. No free structured misconception profile is assumed.
Use native resource reuse and formatting before a loop. No personal student data is needed to draft generic material; external distribution remains outside the proposed automation.
unknowns: Manual correction rate for generated items
research_questions: What fraction of draft questions pass independent solution and ambiguity checks?
Does total authoring time fall after all verification and failed drafts?

already_counted.description: Draft review, revisions and manual fallback

incremental.description: Maintain approved sources and drafting checks

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=20+24+20=64; gross 36%, less 4 upkeep gives net 32%. Low 0 for already reusable material or high draft rejection. No teaching time is removed.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Retain student relationships and intervention judgement while reducing repeated preparation and content drafting.
reach: Align support plans with class teachers
Share checked resources with teaching colleagues
role.ambitious_version: A tutor who prepares checked resources efficiently and uses live time to respond to students.
